items.title: General Mills (GIS) Stock Looks About Right Despite Sugar Pricing Lawsuit
items.summary: General Mills has seen its share price slide over the past few years, even as the business remains a staple supplier across packaged food aisles. That drop puts fresh attention on a basic question for investors: whether the current valuation is still supported by the company’s sales. Over the past 3 years, General Mills stock has fallen 35.7%, which puts a lot of weight on whether its revenue base can still justify where the shares trade today. items.title: General Mills (GIS) Looks Fully Valued After Its Portfolio Shake Up
items.summary: General Mills (GIS) just reshaped its portfolio by exiting yogurt operations in the U.S. and Canada, moving to sell its Brazil unit and mainland China Haagen Dazs shops, and buying into premium pet food. Recent moves have landed in a mixed market backdrop for General Mills. The share price is down 19.82% year to date and the 1-year total shareholder return has declined 21.88%. items.title: Two Beaten-Down Food Stocks Pay 6.5% Yields. Which Dividend Is Safer?
items.summary: Both General Mills and Kraft Heinz offer nearly identical 6.5% yields at beaten-down valuations, but one of them already cut its dividend once and just wrote down billions in brand value for the second year running. Picking the wrong one could leave your retirement income short.
